messages.en:
You always second-guess
yourself. Think of all the
time you'd save if you
stopped doubting yourself.

Deep down inside, most
people think that they're
good people. Even coconut
thieves. Just saying.

The less a person
accomplishes in a day, the
more he talks during
meals. But that's OK.

My mama always said if
you want to avoid looking
like a fool, shut your
mouth.

That horrible raccoon has
forced me into a life
of indentured servitude.
Watch out for yourself!

Is the question "Why is it
bad to do bad things?"
the same as asking
permission?

Some things are better
hollow. Like macaroni.
And donuts. But not
bellies. So eat something!

"To be or not to be..."
"2B? B2! I won! Bingo!"
"That was so corny."
"But it's all I've got."

You can't change what
you've done, so you
might as well just take
pride in it.

You might say this letter
is boring, but did you
ever think that YOU'RE
the boring one? HUH?!

If I had opposable thumbs,
I could take over the
world! Muahahahahaha!

I'm not fat!
I'm just fluffy!

When someone asks a
question and you don't
know the answer, just
yell, "Figure it out!"

Wouldn't it just be super
cool if you had your own
pep squad to cheer you
through life? Y-E-A-H!

Once I save up enough
Bells, I'm outta this
backwater town.

A person's abilities are
tested best when
defending rather than
attacking.

Weeding is very tiring,
especially when you don't
have hands! So weed your
own plot, you lazy bum.

Your skin is as luminous
as Muenster cheese,
sliced fresh daily in the
deli of the heavens.

Your eyes sparkle like
sweet, sweet rock candy,
mined from the depths of
the night sky.

Your nose is like a
succulent new potato,
plucked at the height of
...er...the potato season!

Your shins are like the
finest stalks of celery,
slathered generously with
peanut butter and raisins.

Everything I say is a lie.
Or is it?
Ha ha! You'll never know!

I'll give you 10,000 Bells
if you can guess what I'm
thinking.
Nope, it's not that.

Animal crackers live in
tiny cages before they're
cruelly eaten. Protest
this barbaric process!

If you have a fever and
you don't bother going to
the doctor, you'll find
yourself hard-boiled.

There are plenty of
backless dresses. I would
like to see a backless
suit!

Your elbows are macaroni
cooked al dente in some
celestial kitchen: smooth
with just a hint of bite.

Your head is like a golden
cabbage raised with gem-
encrusted compost in the
gardens of paradise.

Next time you find you're
stuck talking to someone,
yell "Leave me alone!" and
take out your net.

Your earlobes are like
fresh, plump grapes in a
royal fruit salad.
Seedless, of course.

I  c         n   n
   u         O   O
a  t           L
m  e           C

They always say "take
care" when you leave the
doctor's office, but if we
did, they'd be broke!
